name: Chef Alexander Vance
cookingImageAlt: Chef Alexander Vance plating dish over fire grill
quote: Cooking is not merely technical precision; it is an emotional conversation between nature, flame, and the diner's memory.
biography: Trained at L'École Lenôtre in Paris and having led kitchen brigades across 3-star Michelin establishments in Lyon, London, and Tokyo, Chef Vance brings a global, boundary-defying vision to AURA. His signature philosophy marries classical French rigor with Nordic wood-fire simplicity and Asian umami nuances.
philosophy: Every ingredient is respected from root to blossom. We harvest with reverence, cook with passion, and present with quiet elegance.
